title: Agent step event
description: One event per agent step. Holds ids, names, numbers and times, never a prompt, a key or a user's text.

trace_id.description: One per run, the same on every event of the run.

id.description: One per step, unique inside the run.

parent_id.description: The id of the step that started this one. Null on the first step of a run.

agent.description: Stable agent name, such as planner.

cost.description: One currency for the whole project, set by you.
